name: East Berlin Favorites PA 2024
information:
This is a Favorites competition, meaning **competitors may only register for a maximum of 4 events.** If you register for more than 4 events, your registration will not be approved. Please see the [Favorites Format Explanation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EastBerlinFavoritesPA2024#48103-favorites-format-explanation) tab for more info.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
